zh.title: 陽光國家航空因機師轉至達美大幅減班航班
zh.summary: 陽光國家航空CEO承認，因眾多機師轉職達美，該公司大幅削減航班，導致九月明尼阿波利斯機場容量下降近四成。
body: 陽光國家航空的CEO在公開場合承認，自今年八月起，有不少機師離職轉往達美航空。
此種人員流失促使公司主動減少航班排班，以避免無法保證班點的情況發生。
根據該航空公司內部數據，九月份從明尼阿波利斯國際機場出發的座位容量較原計畫減少了近百分之四十。
航空公司表示，此舉是為了應對飛行員 shortage，同時維持現有航線的基本營運需求。
雖然航班削減將影響部分旅客行程，但航空公司強調將盡力安排改簽或退票。

en.title: Sun Country Airlines Cuts Flights as Pilots Move to Delta, CEO Says
en.summary: Sun Country Airlines has announced a significant reduction in its flight schedule after many of its pilots left to join Delta Air Lines, a move acknowledged by the airline’s CEO. The cuts have sharply lowered the carrier’s September capacity at Minneapolis–Saint Paul International Airport, which fell by almost 40 percent compared with previous plans. The airline says the staffing shortage forced the adjustments as it seeks to stabilize operations today.
body: Sun Country Airlines’ CEO admitted in a recent interview that a notable number of pilots have resigned to join Delta Air Lines since August.
The loss of flight crew prompted the airline to pre‑emptively trim its flight schedule to avoid operational disruptions.
Internal data shows that the airline’s September seat capacity out of Minneapolis–Saint Paul International Airport is nearly 40 percent lower than originally planned.
The carrier states that the schedule adjustments are necessary to cope with the pilot shortage while preserving essential route coverage.
Although the cuts will affect some travelers, Sun Country says it will work to re‑book or refund affected passengers where possible.
